result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall. Layout, images, badges, and navigation are aligned and readable. The only notable concern is low-contrast light gray secondary text. The clipped carousel items and the partially visible card at the bottom were excluded as intended scroll and viewport behavior.

issues.description: Secondary text such as the search placeholder, the delivery fee and time lines under restaurant names, and the inactive bottom navigation labels (Search, Orders, Profile) is light gray on white, which may fall below recommended contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken these gray tones to meet WCAG AA contrast (at least 4.5:1 for normal text) while keeping the visual hierarchy.
